ATX closed heading style adds closing hashes

```typescript title="TypeScript"

function main() {
  const options: ConversionOptions = { headingStyle: HeadingStyle.AtxClosed };
  const result = convert("<h1>Closed Heading</h1>", options);
  console.log(result);
}

void main();
```
